curriculum.title: LLM Fundamentals & API Integration
curriculum.description: Understanding Transformer outputs, tokenization, prompt structures, and multi-provider API interaction.

topics.name: Tokenization & Context Windows
topics.description: Subword tokenization mechanisms, token estimation, and context boundary management.

topics.name: LLM API Calling & Parameter Tuning
topics.description: Temperature, top_p, top_k, max_tokens, and system prompt engineering.
learning_objectives: Handle API errors and rate limits

curriculum.title: Structured Outputs & Function Calling
curriculum.description: Enforcing deterministic JSON responses, Pydantic validation, and LLM tool invocation.

topics.name: JSON Schema & Pydantic Validation
topics.description: Guaranteeing JSON structures, handling field constraints, and auto-retry parsing.
learning_objectives: Define Pydantic schema for LLM outputs

topics.name: Function Calling & Tool Definitions
topics.description: Exposing native tools/functions to LLMs and parsing tool call requests.
learning_objectives: Execute function calls returned by models

curriculum.title: Embeddings & Vector Representations
curriculum.description: Dense vector spaces, embedding model selection, and distance metrics.

topics.name: Dense Vector Embeddings
topics.description: Converting text into mathematical vectors, semantic similarity, and dimensionality.
learning_objectives: Explain how embedding models represent semantics
Differentiate cosine similarity vs Euclidean distance

curriculum.title: Document Processing & Chunking Strategies
curriculum.description: Fixed-size, recursive, and semantic document chunking techniques for RAG.

topics.name: Document Chunking Strategies
topics.description: Fixed size chunking, chunk overlap, markdown aware splitting, and semantic boundary detection.
learning_objectives: Select appropriate chunk size and overlap
Evaluate impact of chunking on retrieval quality

curriculum.title: Vector Databases & Indexing
curriculum.description: Storing vectors, HNSW, IVF, similarity search, and Pinecone/FAISS indexing.

topics.name: Vector Database Architecture & Indexing
topics.description: Vector indexing types (HNSW, Flat, IVF), metadata filtering, and retrieval latency tradeoffs.

curriculum.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
curriculum.description: Building naive and advanced RAG pipelines, query expansion, and reranking.

topics.name: RAG Architecture & Retrieval Optimization
topics.description: Connecting vector search to generation, handling context window stuffing, hybrid search, and cross-encoder reranking.

curriculum.title: AI Agent Architecture & LangGraph
curriculum.description: Building stateful, multi-step LLM agents using state graphs and deterministic flow control.

topics.name: Stateful Agent Graphs & Routing
topics.description: Agent state models, node functions, conditional routing edges, and interrupt handling.
learning_objectives: Implement conditional routing based on state

curriculum.title: Agent Memory Systems & Context Compression
curriculum.description: Short-term vs long-term memory, sliding window summaries, and entity extraction.

topics.name: Agent Short-term & Summarized Memory
topics.description: Summarizing conversation history, maintaining key entities, and managing token budgets.
learning_objectives: Compress context without losing critical facts

curriculum.title: RAG Evaluation & LLM-as-a-Judge
curriculum.description: Evaluating retrieval quality and response correctness using automated LLM rubrics.

topics.name: Retrieval & Generation Evaluation Metrics
topics.description: Faithfulness, answer relevance, context precision, context recall, and ground truth benchmarking.

curriculum.title: Production Deployment & Guardrails
curriculum.description: Prompt injection defense, output filtering, latency optimization, and streaming.

topics.name: Prompt Injection Defense & Security
topics.description: Detecting jailbreaks, delimiting untrusted user inputs, and preventing prompt extraction.
